name: Obanazawa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Obanazawa city emblem in white: a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a loop.
history: Municipal flag of Obanazawa, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 2009; the emblem dates from 20 June 1958.

features.role: Obanazawa city emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a loop
